name: move_carton_to_seat
description: Pick the juice carton up from the sofa armrest and put it down on the sofa seat.

source.labelled_by: Claude (in the project chat, from 5 frames of tracked.mp4; not yet via the API)

juice_carton.description: 1 litre juice carton (red, Dubbel Fris), standing upright

armrest.note: top of the left sofa armrest

sofa_seat.note: front edge of the sofa seat, right of the armrest

steps.label: grip the carton near its top with the whole hand
let go of the carton standing on the seat

review: object size 20 x 20 x 40 mm and grasp height 20 mm are assumed, not measured
heights flattened to one table (--flat-table): the demo's measured heights were not used
yaw of every location is 0: the video app does not measure object orientation yet
positions come from body mode (arm scaled to the SO-101, not true millimetres)
vision LLM: the seat cushion is soft: a robot placing here needs a slower release
vision LLM: the carton is about 70 x 70 x 195 mm, much bigger than the twin's test block
